description: Search World Bank loans, credits, and grants by text, country, region, status, sector, theme, financing windows, board date, risk rating, or parent project. Returns borrower, implementing agency, cost and commitment in USD, and portfolio details. For active climate adaptation projects, pass theme: ["Adaptation"], status: ["Active"]. Prefer sector or theme over incidental text matches. For education commitments, start with sector: ["Primary Education", "Secondary Education", "Tertiary Education"]; see sectors[].name. Filters combine by AND. For development statistics, use worldbank_search_indicators and worldbank_get_data.

approved_from.description: Earliest board approval date, inclusive: a real calendar day, on or before approved_to.

approved_to.description: Latest board approval date, inclusive: a real calendar day.

anyOf.description: One code, or several separated by commas, semicolons, or pipes.
Codes; an element holding several separated codes is split too.

countries.description: Borrowing economies by ISO3 or ISO2 code (BRA or BR), or World Bank regional codes for multi-country operations (3W Western and Central Africa, 3E Eastern and Southern Africa, 4E East Asia and Pacific); 3A is the pre-split Africa code, on closed and dropped operations only. Several codes combine as OR. Yemen, DR Congo, West Bank and Gaza, and Timor-Leste are searched under their legacy portfolio codes (RY, ZR, GZ, TP), also accepted as sent. WDI aggregates (SSF, WLD) are rejected: use region. Omit for every country.

es_risk_rating.description: Overall environmental and social risk. H High, S Substantial, M Moderate, L Low. Values combine as OR.

financial_type.description: Financing windows, combined as OR, matched against financialTypes; a project that publishes none never matches.

include_abstract.description: Include each project's full abstract; page size is unchanged.

include_themes.description: Include each project's themes; page size is unchanged, though themes can roughly triple a page. The theme filter works without it.

parent_project_id.description: Find projects linked to this parent ID, such as additional financing.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default); sizes above 1000 are served at that maximum, with a notice.

query.description: Free text matched against project names, abstracts, and objectives; every word must appear. A quoted phrase and AND or OR between words parse; brackets, braces, an unmatched double quote, a slash between words, a trailing backslash, an AND or OR at either end, a trailing NOT, and # are rejected. Omit to browse by filter alone.

region.description: World Bank lending regions, combined as OR; not WDI aggregate codes. Africa is the pre-split region, on closed and dropped operations only; current African operations sit under Eastern and Southern Africa or Western and Central Africa.

enum: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan, and Pakistan

sector.description: Sub-sector names as rows list them in sectors[].name, such as Primary Education or FY17 - Social Protection, not majorSectors names or sector codes. Each name matches in its bare and FY17 - spellings; several combine as OR. A project matches at any share, so weight a sector total by sectors[].percent. Unknown names match nothing; a name must be nonblank with no caret.

status.description: Lifecycle stages, combined as OR: Active (under implementation), Pipeline (approved, not yet effective), Closed (finished disbursing), Dropped (abandoned before approval). Omitted, results are mostly closed operations.

theme.description: Theme names as rows list them in themes[].name (set include_themes), at any of the three levels, such as Adaptation, Gender, or FY17 - Climate change, not theme codes. Each name matches in its bare and FY17 - spellings; several combine as OR. Matching is case-sensitive, and the current and FY17 taxonomies, never mixed on one project, spell some themes differently (pass both Climate Change and Climate change), so check themes[].name on rows of each before relying on one spelling. A project matches at any share, and shares overlap, so weight or threshold by themes[].percent. Unknown names match nothing; a name must be nonblank with no caret.

name: worldbank_search_projects

appliedFilters.description: The search as sent upstream; a filter not applied is omitted.

countries.description: Country codes as sent, each resolved to the portfolio's code (BRA → BR, YEM → RY), comma-joined.

perPage.description: Page size served, after any reduction to the page maximum.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, or the server default; present only when perPage was reduced.

sector.description: Sector names applied, deduplicated, FY17 - prefix removed.

theme.description: Theme names applied, deduplicated, FY17 - prefix removed, case kept.

currentPage.description: Page number; past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_sector_name`: A sector name is blank or contains a caret. `invalid_theme_name`: A theme name is blank or contains a caret. `invalid_country_code`: A country code is malformed, unknown, or a WDI aggregate, or countries holds only separators. `invalid_date`: approved_from or approved_to is not a real calendar day. `reversed_date_range`: approved_from is after approved_to. `invalid_query`: query has syntax the Projects API cannot parse, or contains #. `page_out_of_range`: The page starts past the 100,000-result offset the Projects API serves. `upstream_unavailable`: The Projects API failed (a rate limit, a 408, a 5xx, or an HTML error page), or the country listing that resolves ISO3 codes did not load. `upstream_timeout`: The call's 50-second budget ran out before the Projects API or the ISO3 country listing answered. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Explains an empty result (including whether the country codes match on their own), a page past the end, or a reduced page size.

projects.description: Projects on this page, newest board approval first and undated ones last.

abstract.description: Full abstract as plain text; null when include_abstract is false or none is published.

boardApprovalDate.description: Board approval date, YYYY-MM-DD; a future date is a pipeline project's scheduled one.

closingDate.description: Scheduled or actual closing date, YYYY-MM-DD; null where none is published, as on most dropped operations.

countryCodes.description: Portfolio economy code in ISO2 (YE for Yemen, filed upstream as RY), or World Bank regional code (3W) for a multi-country operation.

countryName.description: Country or region as named in the portfolio.

esRiskRating.description: Published risk code used by es_risk_rating.

financialTypes.description: Financing windows, the values financial_type takes; several on a blended operation, empty where none is published.

grantAmount.description: Grant amount in USD: trust-fund grants and, on some operations, other agencies' co-financing, so not all World Bank money. Independent of financialTypes.

ibrdCommitment.description: IBRD commitment in USD; null, not zero, when no IBRD or IDA amount is published, as on a grant-only operation.

idaCommitment.description: IDA commitment in USD, IDA grants included; null on the same terms as ibrdCommitment.

majorSectors.description: Major sectors, such as Health or Education; empty where none is published. Not accepted by the sector filter.

objective.description: Development objective as plain text; null where none is published. Upstream cuts a few at 8,000 characters.

projectCost.description: Reported project cost in USD, including Bank and non-Bank funding.

sectors.description: Sub-sectors in upstream order; empty where none is published.

name.description: Sub-sector name, the value the sector filter takes.

percent.description: Share of the commitment in percent, usually summing to 100; null on every entry of a project that publishes no split, which is not a zero share.

status.description: Lifecycle stage: Active, Closed, Dropped, or Pipeline.

code.description: Theme code: six digits in the current taxonomy (240102), two or three in the FY17 one (812).

name.description: Theme name, the value the theme filter takes.

parent.description: Theme one level up; null at the top level. A name at two levels appears twice, told apart by parent.

percent.description: Published share in percent. Shares overlap, so they do not add up across themes, and a few older ones exceed 100. Null where none is published, and on every entry of a project whose shares are all zero, which is not a zero share.

themes.description: Themes at all three levels, flattened in upstream order. Null unless include_themes is set; empty where none is published, including some recent operations the theme filter still matches.

totalCommitment.description: Commitment in USD as the project page reports it: ibrdCommitment + idaCommitment + grantAmount. Null where no amount is published, mostly on dropped and older operations — not a zero commitment. Bank lending alone is ibrdCommitment + idaCommitment.

title: Search World Bank Projects
